Egyptica is an extra-dimensional realm created by Mark McLaughlin and Michael Sheehan, Jr. for their Egyptian-themed contributions to the greater Cthulhu Mythos.

page.overview:
What is Egyptica?

Egyptica is an extra-dimensional realm created by Mark McLaughlin and Michael Sheehan, Jr. for their Egyptian-themed contributions to the greater Cthulhu Mythos.

Existing on a separate plane of reality to Earth, Egyptica was said to have been created by the Outer God Nyarlathotep for his followers and their descendants, who dwell there to this day. Access to it is protected by a thick, swirling green fog shot through with bolts of lightning, and it appears to be divided into several sub-regions, including:

Transportation is provided by huge floating pyramids and Egyptian-style barges, likely powered by the magic seemingly possessed by all Egypticans.
